_howToUpdate: This file feeds the 'Programme updates' section and the figures on forest.html.
Leave a value as null until it is confirmed; the page shows it as Pending.
Dates: use YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-09. Links: full https:// addresses, or a file uploaded next to forest.html such as certificates/donation-2026-10.pdf.
Once donation.madeOn is set, the headline switches from 'Estimated trees to be funded' to 'Trees funded by donation'.
To post news, add an entry to 'updates': {"date": "2026-10-09", "title": "Donation made", "body": "Optional detail.", "url": null}. Newest entries show first.
Lines starting with an underscore are notes for staff and are ignored by the page.
